title: Executable Tool-Contract Conformance Testing for Agentic Benchmarks (replication artifact)
description: Replication artifact for an executable-contract audit of four tool-using agent benchmarks (tau2-bench, AgentDojo, MM-ToolSandbox, MedAgentBench). Includes the contract specification language and validator, static and dynamic conformance checkers, benchmark adapters, the two-arm mutation-validation harness, the pre-registered analysis plans committed before scoring, and every generated report table. Audited benchmark clones are not redistributed; they are pinned by upstream commit.
